title: Generate architecture views for a selected customer model
statement: The system shall let a customer generate a read-only architecture browser for one explicitly selected supported project model state without requiring the RigorLoop source checkout or its project-specific content.

what.problem: Repository-specific tooling may fail on customer inputs.
what.desired_outcome: let a customer generate a read-only architecture browser for one explicitly selected supported project model state without requiring the RigorLoop source checkout or its project-specific content.

why.rationale: Customer use needs attributable, portable views and truthful boundaries beyond repository-local demonstration.

conditions: When generating, reading or qualifying the selected architecture browser capability.

contexts: One selected customer project/state and explicitly selected output; declared product generation and reading environments.

how.approach: Assess the stated observable outcomes against explicit supported profiles, selected source identity and actual artifacts; preserve ownership and diagnose unavailable or incomplete results.

how_much.scope: Read-only local generation and portable snapshot reading. No live editor, hosted-service requirement, cross-project aggregation, automatic publication or invented performance target. Detailed realization and platform support are downstream design decisions.

acceptance_criteria: A minimal supported customer model using its own entity IDs can produce Logical, Process, Development, Physical and Scenario entry points without RigorLoop-specific records, contribution tables or local operational history.
The result identifies selected project, declared profile, input content identity, generator version and generation scope. A Git revision alone does not identify changed working-tree content.
Missing, ambiguous or unsupported profile selection yields a specific diagnostic without silently applying another profile; invalid required content prevents publication of a successful snapshot.
If input changes during collection, either use a demonstrably coherent captured selection or report failure; never combine different states under one unqualified identity.
An absent optional view fact remains an explicit absence or limitation rather than making the supported minimal model invalid.

sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
